# Card List

## Summary
Base-realm query-driven card list component. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/components/card-list` (default export
`CardList`).

## API
- `@query` — a card Query; `@realms` — realm URLs to search
- `@format` — render format for each result (embedded, fitted, atom)
- `@isLive` — keep results updating as the realm changes
- `@cards` — alternatively, pre-resolved card components instead of a query
- `@viewOption` — list presentation variant

## Usage
```gts
import CardList from 'https://cardstack.com/base/components/card-list';

<CardList @query={{this.query}} @realms={{this.realms}} @format='embedded' />
```
The linked example is App 2's Talent & Resource Tracker, which consumes this
component directly for its directory views.
